The scatter plot above shows the correspondence between the distance of a house from the nearest public transport facility and its price, in thousands of dollars, among a sample of newly built homes. Which of the following is the trend line of the scatter plot?

choices.value: There is no linear trend in the data

examples.knowledge_point: Identifying the Trendline of a Given Scatter Plot
examples.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13938989/assets/793fd170c89b87cc168ead4bb92613135d503143a8b7f8dc7b7c39a3d2d065fa.png)

Which of the lines $p,q,r,$ or $s$ is the trend line of the scatter plot above?
examples.worked_solution:
The plot shows that the data points are scattered along a curve, not a straight line.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13938989/assets/e2f6a85400c916f198f9dd9fd8b04318d1d4c956c850f5e1e81968993b5d3d53.png)

Therefore, there is no linear trend in the data.
